CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.current_tenant_id()
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select u.tenant_id
  from public.users as u
  where u.id = (select auth.uid())
    and u.active = true
  limit 1;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.current_user_is_active()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select exists (
    select 1
    from public.users as u
    where u.id = (select auth.uid())
      and u.active = true
  );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.has_permission(p_permission_key text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select exists (
    select 1
    from public.users as u
    join public.permissions as p
      on p.key = p_permission_key
    where u.id = (select auth.uid())
      and u.active = true
      and (
        u.role = 'owner'
        or exists (
          select 1
          from private.user_permissions as up
          where up.user_id = u.id
            and up.permission_key = p.key
        )
      )
  );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.is_owner()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select exists (
    select 1
    from public.users as u
    where u.id = (select auth.uid())
      and u.active = true
      and u.role = 'owner'
  );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.has_permission(p_permission_key text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select private.has_permission(p_permission_key);
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_tenant_id()
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  v_tenant_id uuid;
begin
  select u.tenant_id into v_tenant_id
  from public.users u
  where u.id = auth.uid();
  return v_tenant_id;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_my_permissions()
 RETURNS TABLE(permission_key text)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select p.key
  from public.permissions as p
  join public.users as u
    on u.id = (select auth.uid())
   and u.active = true
  where
    u.role = 'owner'
    or exists (
      select 1
      from private.user_permissions as up
      where up.user_id = u.id
        and up.permission_key = p.key
    )
  order by
    p.sort_order,
    p.key;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_my_access_context()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select jsonb_build_object(
    'user_id',
    u.id,

    'email',
    u.email,

    'full_name',
    u.full_name,

    'role',
    u.role,

    'active',
    u.active,

    'tenant',
    jsonb_build_object(
      'id',
      tenant.id,

      'name',
      tenant.name,

      'slug',
      tenant.slug
    ),

    'permissions',
    coalesce(
      (
        select jsonb_agg(
          p.key
          order by p.sort_order, p.key
        )
        from public.permissions as p
        where
          u.role = 'owner'
          or exists (
            select 1
            from private.user_permissions as up
            where up.user_id = u.id
              and up.permission_key = p.key
          )
      ),
      '[]'::jsonb
    )
  )
  from public.users as u
  join public.tenants as tenant
    on tenant.id = u.tenant_id
  where u.id = (select auth.uid())
    and u.active = true
  limit 1;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.list_tenant_members()
 RETURNS TABLE(user_id uuid, email text, full_name text, role text, active boolean, created_at timestamp with time zone, permissions text[])
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_tenant_id uuid;
begin
  /*
   * O usuário precisa estar ativo e possuir members.view.
   *
   * O owner possui essa permissão implicitamente.
   */
  if not private.has_permission('members.view') then
    raise exception using
      errcode = '42501',
      message = 'Você não possui permissão para visualizar os usuários.';
  end if;

  v_tenant_id := private.current_tenant_id();

  if v_tenant_id is null then
    raise exception using
      errcode = '42501',
      message = 'Usuário sem tenant ativo.';
  end if;

  return query
  select
    member.id,
    member.email,
    member.full_name,
    member.role,
    member.active,
    member.created_at,

    case
      /*
       * Owners recebem todo o catálogo de permissões.
       */
      when member.role = 'owner' then
        coalesce(
          (
            select array_agg(
              permission.key
              order by permission.sort_order, permission.key
            )
            from public.permissions as permission
          ),
          array[]::text[]
        )

      /*
       * Members recebem apenas as permissões atribuídas.
       */
      else
        coalesce(
          (
            select array_agg(
              user_permission.permission_key
              order by permission.sort_order, permission.key
            )
            from private.user_permissions as user_permission
            join public.permissions as permission
              on permission.key =
                 user_permission.permission_key
            where user_permission.user_id = member.id
          ),
          array[]::text[]
        )
    end as permissions

  from public.users as member
  where member.tenant_id = v_tenant_id

  order by
    case
      when member.role = 'owner' then 0
      else 1
    end,
    member.full_name nulls last,
    member.email;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.list_stock_movements(p_limit integer DEFAULT 100)
 RETURNS TABLE(id uuid, movement_type text, quantity integer, unit_cost numeric, notes text, created_at timestamp with time zone, product_id uuid, product_name text, product_unit text, created_by uuid, created_by_name text, created_by_email text)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_tenant_id uuid;
  v_can_view_cost boolean;
  v_limit integer;
begin
  if auth.uid() is null then
    raise exception using
      errcode = '42501',
      message = 'Usuário não autenticado.';
  end if;

  if not private.has_permission('stock.view') then
    raise exception using
      errcode = '42501',
      message = 'Você não possui permissão para visualizar o estoque.';
  end if;

  v_tenant_id := private.current_tenant_id();

  if v_tenant_id is null then
    raise exception using
      errcode = '42501',
      message = 'Usuário sem tenant ativo.';
  end if;

  v_can_view_cost :=
    private.has_permission(
      'products.view_cost'
    );

  v_limit := least(
    greatest(
      coalesce(p_limit, 100),
      1
    ),
    500
  );

  return query
  select
    movement.id,
    movement.type,
    movement.quantity,

    case
      when v_can_view_cost
        then movement.unit_cost
      else null::numeric
    end,

    movement.notes,
    movement.created_at,

    product.id,
    product.name,
    product.unit,

    movement.created_by,
    app_user.full_name,
    app_user.email

  from public.stock_movements as movement

  join public.products as product
    on product.id = movement.product_id
    and product.tenant_id = movement.tenant_id

  left join public.users as app_user
    on app_user.id = movement.created_by
    and app_user.tenant_id = movement.tenant_id

  where movement.tenant_id = v_tenant_id

  order by movement.created_at desc

  limit v_limit;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_product(p_product_id uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(id uuid, tenant_id uuid, name text, sku text, description text, image_url text, unit text, cost_price numeric, sale_price numeric, min_stock integer, current_stock integer, active boolean, created_at timestamp with time zone, updated_at timestamp with time zone)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
BEGIN
  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT p.id, p.tenant_id, p.name, p.sku, p.description, p.image_url,
         p.unit, p.cost_price, p.sale_price, p.min_stock, p.current_stock,
         p.active, p.created_at, p.updated_at
  FROM public.products p
  WHERE p.id = p_product_id
    AND p.tenant_id = (SELECT u.tenant_id FROM public.users u WHERE u.id = auth.uid());
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.list_products(p_query text)
 RETURNS TABLE(id uuid, tenant_id uuid, name text, sku text, description text, image_url text, unit text, cost_price numeric, sale_price numeric, min_stock integer, current_stock integer, active boolean, created_at timestamp with time zone, updated_at timestamp with time zone)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_tenant_id uuid;
BEGIN
  SELECT u.tenant_id INTO v_tenant_id
  FROM public.users u
  WHERE u.id = auth.uid();

  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT p.id, p.tenant_id, p.name, p.sku, p.description, p.image_url,
         p.unit, p.cost_price, p.sale_price, p.min_stock, p.current_stock,
         p.active, p.created_at, p.updated_at
  FROM public.products p
  WHERE p.tenant_id = v_tenant_id
    AND (p_query IS NULL OR p_query = '' OR p.name ILIKE '%' || p_query || '%' OR p.sku ILIKE '%' || p_query || '%')
  ORDER BY p.name;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.list_financial_transactions(p_type text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_status text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS TABLE(id uuid, transaction_type text, category text, description text, amount numeric, due_date date, paid_at date, transaction_status text, notes text, created_at timestamp with time zone)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_tenant_id uuid;
  v_type text;
  v_status text;
begin
  if auth.uid() is null then
    raise exception using
      errcode = '42501',
      message = 'Usuário não autenticado.';
  end if;

  if not private.has_permission('finance.view') then
    raise exception using
      errcode = '42501',
      message = 'Você não possui permissão para visualizar o financeiro.';
  end if;

  v_tenant_id := private.current_tenant_id();

  if v_tenant_id is null then
    raise exception using
      errcode = '42501',
      message = 'Usuário sem empresa ativa.';
  end if;

  v_type := upper(
    nullif(btrim(p_type), '')
  );

  v_status := upper(
    nullif(btrim(p_status), '')
  );

  if
    v_type is not null
    and v_type not in ('INCOME', 'EXPENSE')
  then
    raise exception using
      errcode = '22023',
      message = 'Tipo financeiro inválido.';
  end if;

  if
    v_status is not null
    and v_status not in (
      'PENDING',
      'PAID',
      'CANCELLED'
    )
  then
    raise exception using
      errcode = '22023',
      message = 'Status financeiro inválido.';
  end if;

  return query
  select
    transaction.id,
    transaction.type,
    transaction.category,
    transaction.description,
    transaction.amount,
    transaction.due_date,
    transaction.paid_at,
    transaction.status,
    transaction.notes,
    transaction.created_at

  from public.transactions as transaction

  where transaction.tenant_id = v_tenant_id
    and (
      v_type is null
      or transaction.type = v_type
    )
    and (
      v_status is null
      or transaction.status = v_status
    )

  order by
    transaction.due_date asc,
    transaction.created_at desc;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_members_management_data()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_tenant_id uuid;
  v_members jsonb;
  v_permissions jsonb;
begin
  if auth.uid() is null then
    raise exception using
      errcode = '42501',
      message = 'Usuário não autenticado.';
  end if;

  if not private.has_permission('members.view') then
    raise exception using
      errcode = '42501',
      message = 'Você não possui permissão para visualizar usuários.';
  end if;

  v_tenant_id := private.current_tenant_id();

  if v_tenant_id is null then
    raise exception using
      errcode = '42501',
      message = 'Usuário sem empresa ativa.';
  end if;

  select coalesce(
    jsonb_agg(
      member_data.item
      order by
        member_data.owner_order,
        member_data.created_at
    ),
    '[]'::jsonb
  )
  into v_members
  from (
    select
      app_user.created_at,

      case
        when app_user.role = 'owner'
          then 0
        else 1
      end as owner_order,

      jsonb_build_object(
        'id',
        app_user.id,

        'email',
        app_user.email,

        'full_name',
        app_user.full_name,

        'role',
        app_user.role,

        'active',
        app_user.active,

        'created_at',
        app_user.created_at,

        'permissions',
        case
          when app_user.role = 'owner'
            then '[]'::jsonb
          else coalesce(
            (
              select jsonb_agg(
                user_permission.permission_key
                order by
                  permission.sort_order,
                  permission.key
              )
              from private.user_permissions
                as user_permission

              join public.permissions
                as permission
                on permission.key =
                  user_permission.permission_key

              where user_permission.user_id =
                app_user.id
            ),
            '[]'::jsonb
          )
        end
      ) as item

    from public.users as app_user

    where app_user.tenant_id =
      v_tenant_id
  ) as member_data;

  select coalesce(
    jsonb_agg(
      jsonb_build_object(
        'key',
        permission.key,

        'module',
        permission.module,

        'name',
        permission.name,

        'description',
        permission.description,

        'sort_order',
        permission.sort_order
      )
      order by
        permission.module,
        permission.sort_order,
        permission.key
    ),
    '[]'::jsonb
  )
  into v_permissions
  from public.permissions as permission
  where permission.assignable_to_member = true;

  return jsonb_build_object(
    'current_user_id',
    auth.uid(),

    'members',
    v_members,

    'permissions',
    v_permissions,

    'can_manage_permissions',
    private.has_permission(
      'members.permissions'
    ),

    'can_manage_active',
    private.has_permission(
      'members.deactivate'
    ),

    'can_invite',
    private.has_permission(
      'members.invite'
    )
  );
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.list_member_invitations()
 RETURNS TABLE(id uuid, email text, status text, permission_keys text[], expires_at timestamp with time zone, accepted_at timestamp with time zone, revoked_at timestamp with time zone, created_at timestamp with time zone)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_tenant_id uuid;
begin
  if auth.uid() is null then
    raise exception using
      errcode = '42501',
      message = 'Usuário não autenticado.';
  end if;

  if not private.has_permission(
    'members.invite'
  ) then
    raise exception using
      errcode = '42501',
      message = 'Você não possui permissão para visualizar convites.';
  end if;

  v_tenant_id :=
    private.current_tenant_id();

  return query
  select
    invitation.id,
    invitation.email,

    case
      when invitation.status = 'PENDING'
        and invitation.expires_at <= now()
      then 'EXPIRED'
      else invitation.status
    end,

    invitation.permission_keys,
    invitation.expires_at,
    invitation.accepted_at,
    invitation.revoked_at,
    invitation.created_at

  from private.member_invitations
    as invitation

  where invitation.tenant_id =
    v_tenant_id

  order by invitation.created_at desc

  limit 30;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_member_invitation_public(p_token_hash text)
 RETURNS TABLE(email text, company_name text, expires_at timestamp with time zone)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  if p_token_hash is null
    or p_token_hash !~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$'
  then
    return;
  end if;

  return query
  select
    invitation.email,
    tenant.name,
    invitation.expires_at
  from private.member_invitations as invitation
  join public.tenants as tenant
    on tenant.id = invitation.tenant_id
  where invitation.token_hash = p_token_hash
    and invitation.status = 'PENDING'
    and invitation.expires_at > now()
  limit 1;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.create_tenant_with_admin(p_name text, p_slug text, p_user_id uuid, p_email text, p_full_name text)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  v_tenant_id uuid;
begin
  insert into public.tenants (name, slug)
  values (p_name, p_slug)
  returning id into v_tenant_id;

  insert into public.users (id, tenant_id, email, full_name, role)
  values (p_user_id, v_tenant_id, p_email, p_full_name, 'owner')
  on conflict (id) do nothing;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.execute_stock_movement(p_product_id uuid, p_tenant_id uuid, p_type text, p_quantity integer, p_unit_cost numeric, p_notes text, p_new_stock integer)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
begin
  update public.products
  set current_stock = p_new_stock, updated_at = now()
  where id = p_product_id and tenant_id = p_tenant_id;

  insert into public.stock_movements
    (tenant_id, product_id, type, quantity, unit_cost, notes)
  values
    (p_tenant_id, p_product_id, p_type, p_quantity, p_unit_cost, p_notes);
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.set_financial_transaction_status(p_transaction_id uuid, p_target_status text)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  v_tenant_id uuid;
begin
  select tenant_id into v_tenant_id
  from public.users
  where id = auth.uid();

  if v_tenant_id is null then
    raise exception 'Tenant não encontrado';
  end if;

  update public.transactions
  set
    status = p_target_status,
    paid_at = case
      when p_target_status = 'PAID' and paid_at is null then current_date
      when p_target_status in ('PENDING', 'CANCELLED') then null
      else paid_at
    end
  where id = p_transaction_id and tenant_id = v_tenant_id;

  if not found then
    raise exception 'Lançamento não encontrado';
  end if;
end;
$function$
